package: WP-J / WP-Z4c: B3-H3 L1 attempt 5 for private/escalate and private/apologize (receiver-conditioned bridge readout, fresh data)
gate: G-CALLOSUM-UTILITY-002 via unchanged b3bridge.l1_gate (BYTES_W .25, BYTES_NORM 4000, paired mean-2se>0, role_drop<=.01, ood<=.05, reload identical)
motivation: bench-results/b3-l1-escapo-diagnose-20261021 (exploratory, attempt-4 states, seen items): escalate/apologize need a receiver-private fact (capacity/client, decodable 100 % from the receiver state) combined with the sender quantity; the frozen NO_MESSAGE readout under the additive bridge residual costs ORACLE U/F 8.2/9.3 points; the same aux-bridge message with a jointly refit readout gains +8.0/+5.5 points (5/5 seeds); 70-80 % of LATENT errors are within 1 of the threshold

data.templates: identical to attempts 3/4 (V3.make), only the sampling seed changes

states: NEW B1/B2 states computed from the fresh rows after this preregistration is pushed (no reuse of attempt-3/4 states)

bridge_config.epochs: 6 blocks x 10, best on select split
bridge_config.aux: 2 training-only targets U, F standardized on the fit split (as attempt 4)
bridge_config.recv_cond: receiver PCA dim (48): gated Wx/bx re-weighting of the receiver state while the gate is open; gate closed => frozen NO_MESSAGE readout
bridge_config.readout_refit: Bridge.refit_readout after training: standardized logistic readout over [receiver state, gate*message projection] on the fit split, L2 from (1e-3,1e-2,1e-1,1) on the select split, folded into Wx/bx/Wu; message/selector/projectors unchanged

channels: LATENT = recv_cond aux bridge after readout refit (gate input). References, not gate inputs: LATENT_AUX (attempt-4 aux bridge), LATENT_RC_E2E (same bridge before refit). All baselines/controls as attempts 3/4.

tasks.action: replication only (passed in attempt 4): call if U>=8 and F>=8, fix_quietly if U>=8, else schedule

verdict_rule: Per task/view l1_gate twice: SYMBOLIC=label word and SYMBOLIC=attribute level words; canon L1 PASS only if both PASS. strict_scalar reported separately; a strict FAIL is a claim limit. Targets = private/escalate and private/apologize. private/action is a replication of attempt 4 with the new readout; its result is reported but its attempt-4 PASS is not re-decided here. Single run; no re-run with changed settings counts as this attempt; FAIL stays FAIL.
expectation_from_exploration: escalate and apologize: PASS against label and attribute words plausible (exploratory refit 89-91 vs attr words 84-87); strict SCALAR likely FAIL on apologize (SCALAR ~94)
consequence_if_pass: L2 prefix SHADOW experiment allowed for the passing task(s) only; LATENT authority stays 0; frozen runtime unchanged (recv_cond default off)
consequence_if_fail: B3_LATENT stays unavailable on that task; record negative result
claim_limits: the readout refit gives the bridge the same jointly fit readout every baseline already gets; it is a receiver-adapter (L1) change, no backbone injection; synthetic templates; Linux x86_64 cloud CPU, not Redmi
hardware: Linux x86_64 cloud CPU, 4 threads; not Redmi
